label: PF Backlog 478
title: EPIC: Backlog Context model + Epic entity (fields, guards, rollup, retrofit)
body:
## Problem / why
Backlog items carry no shared, understandable context (0/426 have a plain brief; `acceptance_criteria` is
read by grooming + the claim package + task_contract but never authored) and an Epic is not a real entity
(just an item with type=epic; no children rollup, not excluded from dispatch, done is manual).

## Goal & value
Every item carries WHY/WHAT/WHERE/HOW + a captured 360 review + WHO/WHEN/APPROVAL/EVIDENCE; Epic is a real
container whose child user-story backlogs link up, roll up to done, and are never dispatched themselves.

## Children
F1 context fields; F2 epic entity; D1 acceptance_criteria defect; D2 fail-closed guards; M1 migration.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/agent_model_override.py, core/backlog.py, core/backlog_link.py, core/business_models_kb.py
